claims.claim_text: RA 8293 Section 213.1 sets the individual-author term at life plus 50 years after death.
RA 8293 Section 180 allows assignment in whole or in part and requires written indication for inter vivos assignment.
RA 8293 Sections 193, 195, and 198 distinguish moral rights from economic copyright, limit waiver, and state moral rights are not assignable or subject to license.
RA 8293 Sections 216 and 226 provide civil remedies and the four-year damages limit.
Question edits staged locally for 10 linked questions.

unsupported_or_removed_claims: Corrected moral rights from forever/inalienable/unwaivable language to non-assignable/non-licensable, limited-waiver, life-plus-50 language.
Removed unsupported PHP 250,000 statutory-damages wording from linked question and article framing.
Corrected criminal-penalty explanation to local Section 217 text instead of unsupported willfulness/intent-to-defraud shorthand.
Added Section 226 damages-limit caution to delayed infringement remedies.
